1use core::fmt;
2
3#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
4#[repr(transparent)]
5pub struct Glyph(u16);
6
7impl Glyph {
8    /// Construct a glyph from a UTF-16 code unit.
9    #[inline]
10    pub fn from_utf16_code_unit(c: u16) -> Self {
11        Self(c)
12    }
13
14    /// Returns the UTF-16 code unit associated with this glyph.
15    #[inline]
16    pub fn utf16_code_unit(&self) -> u16 {
17        self.0
18    }
19}
20
21macro_rules! glyphs {
22    (
23        $(
24            $code:literal = [$first:ident $(, $rest:ident)*];
25        )*
26    ) => {
27        #[allow(dead_code)]
28        #[allow(non_upper_case_globals)]
29        impl Glyph {
30            $(
31                pub const $first: Glyph = Glyph($code);
32                $(pub const $rest: Glyph = Glyph($code);)*
33            )*
34
35            pub fn from_name(name: &[u8]) -> Option<Self> {
36                // This part is a bit of a hack, since we don't have a nice way
37                // of getting a byte string literal. But, as_bytes is const
38                // since 1.32.
39                $(
40                    const $first: &[u8] = stringify!($first).as_bytes();
41                    $(const $rest: &[u8] = stringify!($rest).as_bytes();)*
42                )*
43
44                match name {
45                    $(
46                        $first => Some(Self::$first),
47                        $($rest => Some(Self::$rest),)*
48                    )*
49                    _ => None,
50                }
51            }
52        }
53
54        impl fmt::Debug for Glyph {
55            fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
56                write!(f, "Glyph(0x{:04x})", self.0)
57            }
58        }
59
60        #[repr(u16)]
61        #[allow(non_camel_case_types)]
62        enum _Reject {
63            $($first = $code,)*
64        }
65    }
66}
